en.title: World Archery Target Face Dimensions & Distance Standards
en.excerpt: Quick reference guide for selecting the correct target face diameters (122cm, 80cm, 6-ring, 40cm) and distances across age groups and bow divisions.
en.content:
Standard Target Face Sizes

World Archery specifies four standardized target face diameters with 10 concentric scoring rings divided into five colored zones (Gold: 10-9, Red: 8-7, Blue: 6-5, Black: 4-3, White: 2-1):

  • 122 cm Face: Used for 70m Recurve, 60m Cadet, and 50m Barebow. (10-ring = 12.2 cm, X-ring = 6.1 cm).
  • 80 cm Face: Used for 50m Compound (6-ring center) and 30m/40m youth divisions. (10-ring = 8 cm, X-ring = 4 cm).
  • 60 cm Face: Used for 25m indoor rounds and developmental archery.
  • 40 cm Face: Standard for 18m Indoor events (Single spot or vertical 3-spot).

Single Spot vs Multi-Spot Faces

For Compound 50m and Indoor 18m, multi-spot faces (individual targets per arrow) are mandatory to prevent arrow damage from tight groupings (known as Robin Hoods).
